design.source: experiments.lung.reference_revision._design; original specification fixed on 1 October 2026 before any result

versions.v1: the published core HLCA reference of lung_pipeline.py (convert_hlca_core.json); labels ann_level_1, ann_level_3 and ann_finest_level of the core store
versions.v2: the core HLCA plus the Kaminski_2020 extension cells with an ILD diagnosis or disease 'normal' (its COPD donors left out, as in part A), in a store mounted on the published full HLCA, with v1's parameters; labels in the columns revision_<level>

labels.coreCells: their v1 labels, read from the core store by cell identifier
labels.revisionCells: the HLCA's annotation of the extension, with ['Unknown', ''] made blank so that they never vote
labels.fallback: a pure annotation revision is not needed: the full HLCA holds the authors' labels; the job stops if they are missing

design.recipe: snapshot of the centre's cells; per version run_mapping (save_k 15, missing features reference_mean) and run_label_transfer at ['ann_level_1', 'ann_level_3', 'ann_finest_level'] with threshold_fraction 0.6; phase 1 with v1, phase 2 with v1 and v2 in the same store
design.unexplained: experiments.lung.lung_analysis: within each lineage (the version's ann_level_1 label), distance to the nearest reference cell above the 99th percentile (inverted_cdf) of the calibration controls' distances to the same version; controls scored leave one out
design.calibration: Natri: its 15 control lungs; the other centres: their own control donors when at least 3, else the controls of the other centres of this experiment with the same assay (Kaminski_2020's controls are reference cells of v2 and calibrate nobody); the same under both versions
design.reads: Zarr stores opened read-only for the published stores and the revised reference, wrapped with experiments/runtime/recording_store.py (cytearc.storage.stores.make_store patched for those locations only, as mounting.py)
design.traceability: v1 labels, votes and distances rebuilt from the frozen v1 label transfers alone, in a new read-only handle with no reference opened, compared exactly with the v1 table of phase 1; artifacts of the v1 and v2 lineages classed reused, new or superseded
design.completeRerun: the Natri recipe with both versions in a fresh store mounted on the published Natri store, alone on the bucket after the Natri update

selection.rule: active core cells, and active Kaminski_2020 extension cells with disease in the ILD diagnoses or 'normal'
